items.title: NEW — `vilan fmt` DECLINES a braced import list at kolt's client.vl:7 — `import std::asset::{ bundle, bundle_as }` — with `reprinting it would have changed the code, so the reprint was thrown away (the formatter's own safety net)`: the round-trip guard fires on a construct the printer should render verbatim, so the file can never be `--check` green on 31c13567; pre-existing (HEAD's and the owner's copies decline identically) and only VISIBLE since N90 gave a decline its own exit code. A formatter bug, not a kolt problem: find which token the reprint moves in a two-leaf braced import (the spaces inside the braces? the trailing comma rule?), pin the round trip, fix the printer
items.discussion: the kolt migration's verifier (2026-09-17, post-seal); found by N90's new exit 2; S
items.body: Reproduce with a one-line file `import std::asset::{ bundle, bundle_as };` under `vilan fmt --check`; `formatter::declines` gains the pin; the printer's import-list arm fixed; `vilan fmt --check` over kolt's src green (the kolt sweep's other fourteen files already are).
